xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4595: pan show --health calls working Herdr agents stuck: CLI never registers the transcript heartbeat lookup

plan.title: pan show --health calls working Herdr agents stuck: CLI never registers the transcript heartbeat lookup
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: pan show <id> --health classifies actively working Herdr agents as stuck. In a fresh CLI process the runtime mirror is empty, a Herdr pane has no tmux window_activity, and the transcript heartbeat lookup in src/lib/agents/liveness.ts is never registered because only src/lib/runtimes/index.ts registers it and nothing on the CLI health path imports that module. pingAgent then falls back to the spawn-time state.json lastActivity, so every Herdr agent older than 30 minutes reads stuck, which invites a false pan resume / pan tell from the Flywheel.
narratives.Proposal: Add a side-effect import of ./runtimes/index.js to src/lib/health.ts so any process that loads the health classifier registers the heartbeat lookup (planning verified with madge that this adds no import cycle and only 7 modules to the show-command graph). Prove it with a new test that runs the real liveness and runtime-registry code against a temp OVERDECK_HOME holding a Herdr-style Claude Code agent with a fresh transcript and a stale state.json, verify the built CLI chunk carries the registration, and record the second registrar in the liveness/runtimes comments and docs/TERMINAL-BACKENDS.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Fixing pan worker wait / pan lane wait idle detection (src/lib/agents/worker/wait.ts) in a CLI process
- Changing the 15/30-minute warning/stuck thresholds in pingAgentBody
- Changing getAgentEffectiveLastActivityMs, isIdle, or idleAgeMs semantics
- Making the runtime mirror available to CLI processes (HTTP fall-through)
- Changing non-Claude runtimes' getHeartbeat implementations
- Importing the runtime registry in src/cli/index.ts for every pan verb
- Editing sync-sources/skills/pan-show/SKILL.md (flags and help text do not change)

autoDecisions.summary: Register the heartbeat lookup by importing ./runtimes/index.js from src/lib/health.ts, not from src/cli/index.ts or the show/health CLI modules.
autoDecisions.rationale: show.ts and cli/commands/health.ts both import pingAgent from lib/health.ts, so one line fixes pan show, pan show --health and pan show --health ping|check; the other importers of lib/health.ts (cloister service*.ts) already load the registry; a CLI-entry import would load the registry for every pan verb.

autoDecisions.summary: Prove the fix with a new test file, tests/lib/health-herdr-heartbeat.test.ts, instead of extending tests/lib/health-runtime-state.test.ts.
autoDecisions.rationale: The existing file mocks liveness.js wholesale and agents.js with five exports, so it cannot observe registration; a separate file can keep liveness and the runtime registry real.

autoDecisions.summary: Leave pan worker wait / pan lane wait (same unregistered lookup) out of scope.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue scopes the health verdict; worker.ts does not import lib/health.ts, and a missing signal there fails toward 'no idle age' rather than a false recovery verdict.

autoDecisions.summary: Fold the built-CLI verification (PRD WI-4) into the WI-1 plan item's acceptance criteria.
autoDecisions.rationale: WI-4 commits nothing, and every plan item must land a commit carrying its Item: trailer for pan task done.

items.title: Import the runtime registry from src/lib/health.ts so the CLI health path registers the transcript heartbeat lookup

expected_outputs: lint-circular-deps.sh exits 0 and scripts/circular-deps-baseline.txt has no diff
the node bundle scan prints FOUND followed by a top-level dist/*.js chunk name

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-1 and WI-4. In src/lib/health.ts, directly after the import from './agents/liveness.js' (line 16), add the bare side-effect import `import './runtimes/index.js';` preceded by the four-line PAN-4595 comment from the PRD. Change nothing else in health.ts. Add `vi.mock('../../src/lib/runtimes/index.js', () => ({}))` to tests/lib/health-runtime-state.test.ts next to its other vi.mock calls (expected: its fs and agents.js mocks lack exports the newly loaded runtime modules read at import time); change none of its assertions, then run it. Run the circular-deps ratchet, boundaries lint and typecheck. Then run npm run build and the Node bundle scan from metadata.verify_commands, and the scratch-home built-CLI check in PRD WI-4 step 2 (fake agent under .tmp/pan-4595-home/agents/agent-pan-99999/ — never use agent-pan-4595, whose real ~/.overdeck/heartbeats file would bypass the transcript path — run both `show PAN-99999 --health --json` and plain `show PAN-99999`, remove it with the literal `rm -rf .tmp/pan-4595-home`). Never commit dist/ or .tmp/.

Add tests/lib/health-herdr-heartbeat.test.ts proving a Herdr agent with a fresh transcript is healthy on the CLI path

expected_outputs: vitest reports 3 passing tests in tests/lib/health-herdr-heartbeat.test.ts and all tests in tests/lib/health-runtime-state.test.ts passing

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-2 exactly. Create tests/lib/health-herdr-heartbeat.test.ts. In beforeEach make a temp dir with mkdtempSync, set process.env.OVERDECK_HOME to it BEFORE vi.resetModules() and the dynamic import of ../../src/lib/health.js, and write agents/agent-pan-4595-heartbeat-test/state.json (role 'work', status 'running', harness 'claude-code', lastActivity 3 h ago), a one-line transcript.jsonl, and sessions.json with one entry whose path is that transcript. Partially mock ../../src/lib/agents/liveness.js with importOriginal, overriding only isAlive to resolve { alive: true, paneAlive: true }; partially mock ../../src/lib/tmux.js so listPaneValuesSync throws and listSessionNames returns Effect.succeed([]). Do not mock or import src/lib/runtimes/index.js. Write the three named tests from the PRD (fresh transcript -> healthy with lastActivity within 60 s; transcript mtime set 3 h back with utimesSync -> stuck; pre-written health.json with consecutiveFailures 2 resets to 0). Restore OVERDECK_HOME and remove the temp dir in afterEach. Once, locally, delete the health.ts import line, confirm the fresh-transcript test fails with status stuck, then restore the line; do not commit that experiment. Follow the PRD's implementation checkpoint and fallback if the real module graph cannot load in the test environment.
